module_summary: Round-robin arbiter with priority rotation: selects one of N requesters per cycle using double-width priority computation and rotating pointer.

anchors.name: req_i
anchors.why: Input request vector specifies which requesters are pending.

anchors.name: gnt_o
anchors.why: Grant output carries arbitrated selection to external requester.

anchors.name: accept_i
anchors.why: Handshake ready signal: requester confirms grant acceptance and triggers priority rotation.

anchors.name: gnt_valid_o
anchors.why: Handshake valid signal: indicates a valid grant is available to requester.

anchors.name: prio_q
anchors.why: One-hot priority pointer rotates each cycle to implement round-robin ordering.

anchors.name: gnt_q
anchors.why: Grant register holds selected requester; drives gnt_o and is updated by combinational next-state.

anchors.name: locked_q
anchors.why: Lock flag: when set, freezes arbitration until accept_i; gates new arbitration cycles.

anchors.name: dbl_req
anchors.why: Doubled request vector for double-width priority selector algorithm.

anchors.name: dbl_gnt
anchors.why: Doubled grant result from priority computation; fed to mux for arbitration decision.

groups.name: Round-robin controller
groups.description: FSM managing grant, priority rotation, and lock state for round-robin arbitration.

groups.name: Priority computation
groups.description: Double-width priority selector: computes highest-priority requester from rotated requests.

groups.name: Request/grant interface
groups.description: Handshake interface bundling requests, grant, and flow-control signals.
